title: Native LPC spellcasting with preserved traveler appearance
notes: Revised LPC has no cast action. Expanded LPC authors supplied seven spellcast poses for compatible thin bodies and revised clothing. Original head and hairstyle frames follow pixel-verified native head offsets. Source and derived-asset licenses are recorded individually.
